versions.subject: rule: Lazarus activity
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'reg.exe save hklm\sam %temp%\~reg_sam.save'
        - '1q2w3e4r@#$@#$@#$'
        - ' -hp1q2w3e4 '
        - '.dat data03 10000 -p '
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'process call create'
        - ' > %temp%\~'
selection3:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'netstat -aon | find '
        - ' > %temp%\~'
# Network share discovery
selection4:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.255 10 C:\ProgramData\\'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*reg.exe save hklm\\sam %temp%\\~reg_sam.save*", "*1q2w3e4r@#$@#$@#$*", "* -hp1q2w3e4 *", "*.dat data03 10000 -p *") OR (CommandLine="*process call create*" CommandLine="* > %temp%\\~*") OR (CommandLine="*netstat -aon | find *" CommandLine="* > %temp%\\~*") OR CommandLine="*.255 10 C:\\ProgramData\\*"
